review_scope: sealed reader/current contract/layout, not native files or execution
findings: Candidate sourceSHA and its returned offsets do not independently qualify native table discovery. Re-reading/slicing/roundtripping candidate output is self-confirming.
Pinned tolerant MMD reader is a shared layout authority and cannot recover raw-name/negative-ref/truncation losses.
Qualification must remain per exact private input/profile; no general PMX/solver/HAS join follows.
Parser count/operation/output limits do not prove peak heap or elapsed time; a future read wrapper requires separately enforced wall/memory/process ownership.
resolution_in_proposal: Explicit independent oracle-first witness admission and unimplemented readiness gates, separate private identity/strict comparison/resource runner, no native commands/stager, per-input table scope and strict public scalar projection.
